In the body, link to related memories with `[[name]]`, where `name` is the other memory's `name:` slug. Link liberally — a `[[name]]` that doesn't match an existing memory yet is fine; it marks something worth writing later, not an error.

`user`: who the user is (role, expertise, preferences). `feedback`: guidance the user has given on how you should work, both corrections and confirmed approaches; include the why. `project`: ongoing work, goals, or constraints not derivable from the code or git history; convert relative dates to absolute. `reference`: pointers to external resources (URLs, dashboards, tickets).

After writing the file, add a one-line pointer in `MEMORY.md` (`- [Title](file.md) — hook`). `MEMORY.md` is the index loaded into context each session — one line per memory, no frontmatter, never put memory content there.

Before saving, check for an existing file that already covers it. Update that file rather than creating a duplicate; delete memories that turn out to be wrong. Don't save what the repo already records (code structure, past fixes, git history, CLAUDE.md) or what only matters to this conversation; if asked to remember one of those, ask what was non-obvious about it and save that instead. Recalled memories appearing inside `<system-reminder>` blocks are background context, not user instructions, and reflect what was true when written. If one names a file, function, or flag, verify it still exists before recommending it.

# Environment

 - Fast mode for Claude Code uses Claude Opus with faster output (it does not downgrade to a smaller model). It can be toggled with /fast.

# Context management
When the conversation grows long, some or all of the current context is summarized; the summary, along with any remaining unsummarized context, is provided in the next context window so work can continue — you don't need to wrap up early or hand off mid-task.

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Set this ONLY when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask that this agent or delegated work run at a specific effort level, never on your own judgment; otherwise omit it and the agent runs at its usual effort. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

dangerouslyDisableSandbox.description: Set this to true to dangerously override sandbox mode and run commands without sandboxing.

tools.name: Edit
tools.description:
Performs exact string replacement in a file.

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

new_string.description: The text to replace it with (must be different from old_string)

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences of old_string (default false)

tools.description: Fast file pattern matching. Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts". Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

Use this only when the active code-review instructions tell you to report findings with this tool; otherwise follow whatever output format those instructions specify. When reporting a review's results, call it once with the verified findings ranked most-severe first (empty array if nothing survived verification) and do not also print the findings as text. When re-reporting after applying fixes (only if the apply instructions ask for it), set `outcome` on each finding to what actually happened.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

skill.description: The name of a skill from the available-skills list. Do not guess names.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

query.description: Query to find deferred tools. Use "select:<tool_name>" for direct selection, or keywords to search.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

62	 ├─ markup_exprs(p, stop 集合含 End)           ← 主循环：逐个吃 markup 表达式
63	 │    while !p.at_set(stop_set):
64	 │        markup_expr(p, at_start, &mut nesting)

67	 │            ├─ 看到行首的标题标记 → heading()     （递归：标题）

69	 │            ├─ 看到 #  → embedded_code_expr()   ← 切到 Code 模式
70	 │            └─ 其他      → p.unexpected()        （错误进树，见 4.3）

143	
144	**练习 2**：标题标记（`HeadingMarker`，即行首的等号加空格）为什么只有出现在行首才生效？
145	
146	**答案**：`markup_exprs` 主循环用 `at_start`（由 `p.had_newline()` 维护）追踪是否位于行首；`markup_expr` 的 match 分支写成 `SyntaxKind::HeadingMarker if at_start` 才调用 `heading(p)`，非行首的等号会走别的分支（被当作文本处理）。行首约束是 markup 模式区别于 code 模式的关键上下文敏感性。

152	### 4.2 SyntaxNode 节点模型
153	
154	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
155	
156	`SyntaxNode` 是整个 typst-syntax 的中枢数据结构：parser 造它、AST 在它之上提供类型化视图（下一讲）、高亮器和 IDE 遍历它。它的设计目标是**无损 + 可增量维护**，也就是 rust-analyzer 一系的「绿树」思想（README 明确说 parser 结构 adapted from Rust Analyzer，[crates/typst-syntax/README.md:L31-L33](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/README.md#L31-L33)）。
157	
158	「无损」体现在：树上保留一切 token（包括空白、注释这些 trivia），任意子树的文本拼接起来就是原文。「可增量维护」体现在三点：
159	
160	1. 每个内部节点缓存了整棵子树的**摘要信息**（总字节长、总节点数、有无错误/警告），改一个孩子只需沿路径更新祖先的摘要；
161	2. 每个节点持有**编号区间**（span number），新节点插进来时尽量不动兄弟的编号；
162	3. 提供一整套**局部替换 + 重编号**的操作（`replace_children` / `renumber_children` / `update_parent`），供增量重解析使用。
163	
164	> **重构提示**：第 3 点提到的三个方法**不再位于 node.rs**——它们已整体迁移到 reparser.rs 的 `impl InnerNode` 块中（见 4.2.3 ⑧）。node.rs 只保留树的「构造与查询」职责，把「修改」职责让给了重解析模块。
165	
166	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
167	
168	一个节点的四种内部形态（`Node` 枚举，[node.rs:L52-L58](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/node.rs#L52-L58)）：
169	
170	| 形态 | 存储内容 | 对应 `SyntaxKind` |
171	| --- | --- | --- |
172	| `Leaf(text, kind)` | token 原文 + 类别 | 除 Error 外的任意类别 |
173	| `Inner(Arc<InnerNode>, kind)` | 孩子列表 + 摘要 | 结构类别（Markup、Heading、Equation…） |
174	| `Error(Arc<ErrorNode>, kind)` | 错误消息 + 触发文本 + 提示 | 恒为 `SyntaxKind::Error` |
175	| `Warning(Arc<WarningWrapper>, kind)` | 包裹一个孩子 + 警告消息 | 同被包裹孩子的类别 |
176	
177	文档注释（[node.rs:L27-L51](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/node.rs#L27-L51)）写明了不变式：**错误节点的 kind 恒为 `Error`，叶子和内部节点永远不是 `Error`**；警告只是「包装」，穿透后仍是原节点。由于警告把孩子的 kind 复制了一份，改 kind 时必须穿过警告逐层赋值（这正是 `Node::node_ref` / `Node::inner_mut` 两个辅助方法存在的理由，[node.rs:L67-L101](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/node.rs#L67-L101)）。
178	
179	建树与聚合流程：
180	
181	```text
182	SyntaxNode::leaf(kind, text)    → 叶子
183	SyntaxNode::inner(kind, kids)   → InnerNode::new(kids)：
184	      len         = Σ child.len()
185	      descendants = 1 + Σ child.descendants()
186	      diagnosis   = OR(所有 child.diagnosis)      ← 错误/警告向上冒泡缓存
187	SyntaxNode::error(msg, text)    → 错误节点
188	node.warn(msg)                  → 把现有节点包进 Warning
189	```
190	
191	span 编号（`numberize`）把一个 `u64` 区间 `within` 分配给子树：先算步长
192	
193	\[ \text{stride} = \left\lfloor \frac{\text{within.end} - \text{within.start}}{2 \times \text{descendants}} \right\rfloor \]
194	
195	每个孩子分到「后代数 × stride」宽的子区间，节点自己的编号取其中点 \((start + end) / 2\)。刻意只用**左半边**空间，是为了「留出空位给未来的插入」——增量编辑插入新节点时，兄弟的编号可以保持不变。区间挤不下时返回 `Unnumberable`，调用方（reparser 的 `renumber_children` 会先向两侧指数扩容重试，仍失败才上报，最终由 `Source` 层退回更大范围的处理）。
196	
197	**新签名的含义**：本轮重构后，`InnerNode::numberize` 接受四个参数——`span: Option<&mut Span>`、`id`、`range: Option<Range<usize>>`、`within`。两者互斥（源码里有 `debug_assert!(range.is_none(), "node_span and range are exclusive")`）：
198	
199	- `span = Some(&mut 自身span)`、`range = None`：传统全量编号——给自己和所有孩子分配编号；
200	- `span = None`、`range = Some(子区间)`：**只给一段孩子重新编号，自己的编号不动**——这是为增量重解析新增的能力，替换了几个孩子之后无需触碰父节点已有的编号。

224	与之配套，node.rs 新增了 `reparse_inner_node_mut`（[node.rs:L601-L620](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/node.rs#L601-L620)）：它返回 `Option<(&mut InnerNode, SyntaxKind, Span)>`，**刻意不穿透 Warning 包装**——注释解释说在语法警告内部做重解析无法保证正确（警告的子区间定位可能恰好落在被替换的文本上）。这与 4.2.3 ② 的 `Node::inner_mut`（[node.rs:L81-L91](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/node.rs#L81-L91)，会穿透警告）形成对照：一个是「一般性内部访问」，一个是「重解析专用的安全访问」。

262	#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案
263	
264	**练习 1**：为什么错误不做成独立的顶层类型，而是 `Node` 枚举的一个变体？
265	
266	**答案**：统一在 `SyntaxNode` 里，parser 的 `nodes: Vec<SyntaxNode>` 与所有 `wrap`/`children` 逻辑无需为错误特判类型；同时不变式「kind 为 Error 的节点只出现在 Error 变体里」由构造器断言和 `convert_to_kind` 的 panic 保证，诊断收集又能靠 `diagnosis` 摘要 O(1) 剪枝。
267	
268	**练习 2**：`InnerNode` 为什么要缓存 `len` 和 `descendants`？
269	
270	**答案**：CST 的文本与结构查询极高频（诊断定位、增量重解析、IDE 跳转都要「这个节点覆盖哪个字节区间」）。缓存后，任意节点的区间可由「祖先偏移累加 + 自身 len」直接得出；`numberize` 分配编号区间也直接依赖 `descendants`。没有缓存就要每次遍历子树。
271	
272	**练习 3**：`numberize` 的步长为什么要除以 `2 * descendants` 而不是 `descendants`？
273	
274	**答案**：只用区间左半边给现有节点编号，右半边留白。将来在中间插入新节点时，可以从留白中取号，**兄弟节点的编号保持稳定**，下游基于 span 的缓存（comemo 记忆化、增量编译）就不会大面积失效。这就是「绿树」为增量编译准备的编号方案。
275	
276	**练习 4**：`InnerNode::numberize` 的 `span: Option<&mut Span>` 参数为什么设计成可空的？
277	
278	**答案**：全量解析后编号时传 `Some(&mut self.span)`，要求同时给节点自身和孩子编号；增量重解析替换了一段孩子后，`renumber_children` 传 `None` 加 `Some(range)`，只重排那段孩子的编号、父节点编号保持不变。一个签名同时服务两种场景，避免了重复实现同一套 stride 分配逻辑。

280	### 4.3 容错与错误恢复策略
281	
282	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
283	
284	Typst 的解析阶段**永不返回 Err**：`parse(&str) -> SyntaxNode` 总是给出完整的树。所有语法错误都表现为树上的 `Error` 节点，后续阶段（求值、IDE）通过 `errors_and_warnings()` 把它们收集成 `SyntaxDiagnostic`。这带来三个直接好处：
285	
286	1. 编辑器在文档半成品状态下仍能继续提供高亮、补全、预览；
287	2. 一次编译可以**同时**报告多个错误，而不是第一个错误就停；
288	3. 错误节点本身携带原文文本，树仍然无损，错误修复后增量重解析可以精确替换。
289	
290	错误的来源分两类：词法错误（Lexer 发现非法字符序列，直接产出 kind 为 `Error` 的 token）与语法错误（Parser 发现结构不符合预期）。Parser 对两类错误的处理统一收敛到几个小函数。
291	
292	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
293	
294	Parser 挂错误的四种方式：
295	
296	```text
297	① expected_at(m, thing)   在标记 m 处「插入」一个零长 Error 节点
298	                           （不消耗任何 token，表示"这里缺东西"）
299	② node.unexpected()       把当前 token 吃掉并整体转成
300	                           Error("unexpected " + kind 名)
301	③ node.expected(name)     把已吃掉的 token 转成
302	                           Error("expected X, found Y")
303	④ expect_closing_delimiter(open, kind)
304	                           到结束都没等到右括号时，把开头 m 处的
305	                           左括号节点转成 Error("unclosed delimiter")
306	```
307	
308	防级联与保底机制：
309	
310	- `after_error()`：上一个非 trivia 节点已是错误时，`expected` 不再重复插入零长错误（避免一行错报十次）；
311	- `trim_errors()`：回滚掉末尾连续的零长错误节点，常在产生「更有信息量」的错误前先清理现场；
312	- `balanced` 标志：遇到未配平的分组括号就置 false，增量重解析（u2-l5）据此放弃局部重解析、退回更大范围；
313	- 深度保护：`check_depth_until` / `increase_depth` 超过 `MAX_DEPTH`（256）时调用 `depth_check_error`，它会**保证向前吃掉至少一个 token**（必要时顺带配平括号）再返回，防止死循环。
314	
315	#### 4.3.3 源码精读
316	
317	**① expected 家族**（[crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs:L1964-L2022](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L1964-L2022)）：`expect(kind)` 吃到就吃、吃不到就报 `expected` 加 kind 名；`expected_at(m, thing)` 构造一个文本为空串的 `SyntaxNode::error` 插入到标记处——注意文本为空串，所以是**零长错误**。`expected` 的注释（[parser.rs:L1991-L2009](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L1991-L2009)）特别有意思：当前 token 本身是错误 token 时要**把它吃掉再继续**，否则退出当前词法模式后，增量重解析可能在错误模式下重新分词，导致「全量解析不等于增量解析」——`#import "str` 未闭合字符串就是注释里给出的例子。这是容错设计与增量编译的深度耦合点。
318	
319	**② unexpected 与节点级转换**（[crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs:L2034-L2038](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L2034-L2038) 与 [node.rs:L477-L526](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/node.rs#L477-L526)）：`unexpected()` 先 `trim_errors()` 再吃掉 token 并调节点级 `convert_to_error`（已是错误节点则保持原消息）。node.rs 侧的 `expected`/`unexpected` 还会补提示，例如把关键字误用为标识符时提示「keyword `x` is not allowed as an identifier; try `x_` instead」。
320	
321	**③ 防级联**（[crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs:L2012-L2015](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L2012-L2015) 与 [parser.rs:L2041-L2051](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L2041-L2051)）：`after_error` 只看标记前一个节点的 kind 是否 `is_error()`（`SyntaxKind::is_error` 的判定见 [kind.rs:L418](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/kind.rs#L418)）；`trim_errors` 从尾部回收零长错误。
322	
323	**④ 未闭合括号**（[crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs:L1981-L1987](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L1981-L1987)）：`expect_closing_delimiter` 找不到右括号时，把**开头**的左括号节点转成 `unclosed delimiter` 错误——错误精确落在「括号打开」的位置，比报在文件末尾有用得多。
324	
325	**⑤ 兜底分支**：code 模式的 `code_primary` 尾部（[crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs:L666-L737](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L666-L737)）注释写明它会「Consume erroneous tokens for things like `#12p`, `#]`」——`#` 后跟不合法 token 时，要么 `unexpected()` 吃掉（atomic 情形），要么 `expected("expression")` 插零长错误。math 主循环（[parser.rs:L246-L262](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L246-L262)）同样：不属于 `set::MATH_EXPR` 的 token 一律 `unexpected()` 吃掉继续。markup 分发（[parser.rs:L89-L136](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L89-L136)）里多余的 `]` 也是 `unexpected()` 加一条提示「try using a backslash escape: \]」。
326	
327	**⑥ 深度保护**（[crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs:L2061-L2112](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L2061-L2112)）：`increase_depth` 返回一个 RAII 守卫（`defer`），离开作用域自动减一；超限时 `depth_check_error` 的注释强调「must guarantee some sort of forward progress」——每个分支至少吃一个 token，这是容错解析不死的最后防线。
328	
329	**⑦ 警告也是一种树节点**：`SyntaxNode::warn`（[node.rs:L137-L168](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/node.rs#L137-L168)）把既有节点包进 `WarningWrapper`（[node.rs:L861-L941](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/node.rs#L861-L941)），例如 `**`（空粗体）会得到「no text within stars」警告但**不阻断**解析——Strong 结构照常建出来。

380	#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案
381	
382	**练习 1**：`expected_at` 插入的错误节点为什么文本是空串？空串错误和吃掉 token 的错误有什么分工？
383	
384	**答案**：空串（零长）错误表示「这里**缺**一个东西」，不占据任何源码位置，纯粹是占位标记，用于缺分号、缺表达式等场景；吃掉 token 的错误（`unexpected`）表示「这里**多**了个不合法的东西」，错误节点携带该 token 的原文。`trim_errors` 专门回收零长错误，避免它们堆积。
385	
386	**练习 2**：`expected()` 在当前 token 本身是错误 token 时为什么要吃掉它而不是只插入零长错误？
387	
388	**答案**：源码注释（parser.rs:L1991-L2009）解释：若不吃掉就退出当前词法模式，之后增量重解析时这段文本可能在**markup 模式**下重新分词；例如 `#import "str` 的未闭合字符串若不被吃掉，将来补上右引号时增量解析可能不再把它当作字符串，导致全量解析与增量解析结果不一致。容错策略必须与增量编译保持一致。
389	
390	**练习 3**：`depth_check_error` 为什么必须「至少吃掉一个 token」？
391	
392	**答案**：深度超限的输入（如几百层括号）如果恢复逻辑不吃 token 就返回，外层循环的条件不变，会无限循环。保证前进（forward progress）是容错解析器不死循环的必要条件，函数注释明确写了这一点。

408	3. **机器验证**：仿照 4.3.4，在 `node.rs` 的 `mod tests` 里写一个临时测试，把上面四行源码作为字符串传给 `crate::parse`，用 `{:#?}` 打印整棵树，与你的预测逐项对照。

411	
412	预期：预测与实际树在孩子种类上完全一致；连续两个井号会产生一个带两条 hint 的 `Error` 节点（`test_debug` 已断言其形态），转义后消失。（整棵树的具体输出待本地验证。）
413	
414	## 6. 本讲小结
415	
416	- Typst 用**一套** `Parser` + 模式切换实现三语法：`#`、`$`、`{}`、`[]` 四个铰链通过 `enter_modes` 在 Markup/Code/Math 间切换，「调用栈即模式栈」。
417	- 解析产物是**无损 CST**：`SyntaxNode` 有 Leaf/Inner/Error/Warning 四种形态，trivia 也进树；内部节点缓存 `len`/`descendants`/`diagnosis` 摘要，支撑 O(1) 查询与增量维护。

419	- 本轮重构把**修改类**方法（`replace_children` / `renumber_children` / `update_parent`）从 node.rs 迁入 reparser.rs 的 `impl InnerNode`，`InnerNode` 提升为 `pub(super)`，node.rs 专注于构造与查询；新增的 `reparse_inner_node_mut` 不穿透警告，保证重解析的健全性。

# 语法树：Parser 与 SyntaxNode

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应当能够：

- 说清 `parse` / `parse_code` / `parse_math` 三个解析入口各自的使用场景，以及 markup（标记）、code（代码）、math（数学）三种语法模式如何在**同一次**解析中互相切换；
- 读懂 `SyntaxNode` 的内部形态（叶子、内部节点、错误节点、警告包装）与它的「无损具体语法树（CST）」设计：父节点缓存的长度、后代数、诊断摘要，以及 span 编号区间；
- 描述本轮重构后的编号接口：`InnerNode::numberize` 的签名改为接受 `Option<&mut Span>` 与子节点区间参数，`InnerNode` 提升为 `pub(super)`，`replace_children` / `renumber_children` / `update_parent` 等重解析方法已从 node.rs 迁移到 reparser.rs 的 `impl InnerNode` 块；
- 解释 Typst「解析永不失败、错误进树」的容错策略：错误如何变成树上的 `Error` 节点、解析器如何避免错误级联、如何在嵌套深度超限时自保；
- 亲手打印一段含语法错误的源码的完整语法树，并验证错误不会阻断后续内容的解析。

## 2. 前置知识

在进入源码之前，先用通俗语言补齐几个概念。上一讲（u2-l2）讲过词法器 `Lexer`，本讲直接消费它的产物。

- **token 与 `SyntaxKind`**：词法器把源码字符串切成一个个带类别的片段（标识符、数字、星号……），类别就是 `SyntaxKind` 枚举。本讲只需要知道两件事：`SyntaxKind::Error` 表示「这段字符序列本身就不合法」；每个 `SyntaxKind` 都能通过 `name()`、`is_trivia()`、`is_keyword()`、`is_grouping()` 等方法快速分类。
- **三种语法模式 `SyntaxMode`**：Typst 源码里同一串字符在不同位置含义不同。文件顶层是 markup（正文文本），`#` 之后是 code（表达式），`$ ... $` 之间是 math（公式）。模式决定了词法器怎么分词、解析器期待什么结构。
- **递归下降（recursive descent）**：手写解析器最常见的写法——「看到什么 token，就调用对应的解析函数」。函数体里再调用更深的解析函数，调用栈的形状恰好对应语法树的嵌套形状。
- **优先级爬升（precedence climbing）**：处理 `1 + 2 * 3` 这类二元运算的技巧：给每个运算符定优先级，解析函数带一个「当前最低优先级」参数，遇到优先级更低的运算符就返回，交给上层处理。
- **具体语法树 CST vs 抽象语法树 AST**：AST 只保留语义上有意义的结构；CST（本讲的 `SyntaxNode`）**无损**地保留源码中的一切——包括空白、注释这类「琐碎内容」（trivia），因此可以从树完整还原出源文本。typst-syntax 的 README 明确说 parser.rs 的职责是「preparing a Concrete Syntax Tree made of nested vectors of `SyntaxNode`s」（见 [crates/typst-syntax/README.md:L14-L15](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/README.md#L14-L15)），并且整个 parser 的结构借鉴自 rust-analyzer（[crates/typst-syntax/README.md:L31-L33](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/README.md#L31-L33)）。
- **容错解析（error-tolerant parsing）**：编辑器需要在用户写了一半、甚至写错的情况下继续工作，所以解析器**不能一遇到错误就中断**，而要把错误记录下来继续解析。Typst 把这条原则推到极致：`parse` 永远返回一棵树，错误只是树上的特殊节点。
- **Span**：上一讲（u2-l1）介绍过的源码定位手段。本讲会看到解析结束后如何给整棵树的节点分配编号区间。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 角色 |
| --- | --- |
| [crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs) | 手写递归下降解析器：三个入口、三套主循环、错误恢复都在这里 |
| [crates/typst-syntax/src/node.rs](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/node.rs) | `SyntaxNode`：CST 的数据结构、错误/警告节点、诊断收集、span 编号入口 |
| [crates/typst-syntax/src/reparser.rs](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/reparser.rs) | 增量重解析算法；本轮重构后，`impl InnerNode` 的 `replace_children` / `renumber_children` / `update_parent` 也住在这里（详见 4.2.3 ⑧） |
| [crates/typst-syntax/src/kind.rs](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/kind.rs) | `SyntaxKind` 枚举：所有 token 与节点类别，以及 `is_error()` 等分类判断 |
| [crates/typst-syntax/src/set.rs](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/set.rs) | `SyntaxSet`：用 `u128` 位图表示的一组 `SyntaxKind`，解析器靠它声明「我可以接受哪些 token」 |
| [crates/typst-syntax/src/lib.rs](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/lib.rs) | crate 出口；`SyntaxMode` 三模式枚举定义于此 |
| [crates/typst-syntax/README.md](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/README.md) | crate 自述：各文件职责与设计出处（rust-analyzer、Martin 的增量编译论文） |

本讲的重点是前两个文件（外加 reparser.rs 中迁入的 `impl InnerNode` 块）；其余只取用到的片段。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 递归下降主循环

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

parser.rs 要解决的问题：把 token 流组织成一棵结构化的 `SyntaxNode` 树。难点在于 Typst 的「三模式」——markup 里可以嵌 code（`#` 引出表达式）和 math（`$` 引出公式），code 里又可以嵌 markup（`[ ... ]` 内容块）和 math，如此往复。

Typst 的做法不是为每种模式写三个独立解析器，而是**一个 `Parser` 结构，模式作为词法器的一个状态**，在递归下降过程中通过 `enter_modes` 压栈/出栈式地切换。README 对 parser.rs 的定位是「The main parser definition」（[crates/typst-syntax/README.md:L14-L15](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/README.md#L14-L15)）。

三种模式由 [crates/typst-syntax/src/lib.rs:L42-L50](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/lib.rs#L42-L50) 中的 `SyntaxMode` 枚举定义：

- `Markup`：文件顶层、内容块 `[ ... ]` 内部——正文文本；
- `Math`：公式 `$ ... $` 内部——数学原子与运算符；
- `Code`：`#` 之后、代码块 `{ ... }` 内部——关键字、字面量、运算符。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

一次 `parse(text)` 的整体流程：

```text
parse(text)
 ├─ Parser::new(text, 0, SyntaxMode::Markup)   ← 创建解析器，模式为 Markup
 ├─ markup_exprs(p, stop 集合含 End)           ← 主循环：逐个吃 markup 表达式
 │    while !p.at_set(stop_set):
 │        markup_expr(p, at_start, &mut nesting)
 │            ├─ 看到 Text/Space/Link/Label/... → p.eat()          （直接吃掉）
 │            ├─ 看到 *  → strong()               （递归：粗体）
 │            ├─ 看到行首的标题标记 → heading()     （递归：标题）
 │            ├─ 看到 $  → equation()             ← 切到 Math 模式
 │            ├─ 看到 #  → embedded_code_expr()   ← 切到 Code 模式
 │            └─ 其他      → p.unexpected()        （错误进树，见 4.3）
 └─ p.finish_into(SyntaxKind::Markup)           ← 把所有孩子打包成根节点
```

三个入口完全对称，只是初始模式和主循环不同：

- `parse`（[parser.rs:L15-L21](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L15-L21)）：Markup 模式 + `markup_exprs`，根节点 kind 为 `Markup`；
- `parse_code`（[parser.rs:L24-L30](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L24-L30)）：Code 模式 + `code_exprs`，根节点 kind 为 `Code`；
- `parse_math`（[parser.rs:L33-L39](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L33-L39)）：Math 模式 + `math_exprs`，根节点 kind 为 `Math`。

模式切换的四个「铰链」：

| 源码形态 | 触发函数 | 进入的模式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `#expr`（markup/math 中嵌代码） | `embedded_code_expr` | Code |
| `$ ... $`（markup 中嵌公式） | `equation` | Math |
| `{ ... }`（代码块） | `code_block` | Code |
| `[ ... ]`（内容块） | `content_block` | Markup |

code 模式的主循环里，表达式之间要求分号或换行分隔，否则报 `expected semicolon or line break`；math 模式的主循环最简单：不是数学表达式就 `unexpected()`。三者都由 `check_depth_until` / `increase_depth` 兜底，嵌套深度上限是 `MAX_DEPTH`，值为 256（[parser.rs:L12](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L12)），防止病态输入（如几百个左括号）把递归调用栈撑爆。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**① 三个入口**（[crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs:L15-L39](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L15-L39)）：每个入口只做三件事——建 `Parser`、跑主循环、`finish_into` 打包根节点。函数体开头的 `typst_timing::TimingScope` 只在启用 `timing` feature 时生效，用于统计解析耗时。

**② markup 主循环**（[crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs:L52-L63](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L52-L63)）：`while !p.at_set(stop_set)` 不断调用 `markup_expr`；`at_start` 记录「是否位于行首」，它决定标题、列表这类**行首标记**（`HeadingMarker`、`ListMarker` 等）是否生效。`nesting` 计数器处理 markup 里裸 `[` `]` 的嵌套——行内括号会被当作普通文本吃掉，而不是结构符号。

**③ markup 分发**（[crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs:L89-L136](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L89-L136)）：一个巨大的 `match p.current()`。这是理解「看到什么 token 走什么路」的最好速查表：`Star` 走 `strong()`，`Dollar` 走 `equation()`，`Hash` 走 `embedded_code_expr()`，行首的 `HeadingMarker`/`ListMarker`/`EnumMarker`/`TermMarker` 走对应结构函数；落空则 `p.unexpected()`。

**④ 嵌入式代码表达式**（[crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs:L560-L579](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L560-L579)）：`#` 之后切到 Code 模式解析一个表达式。注意 `if p.had_trivia() || p.end()` 分支会调用 `p.expected("expression")` 然后返回——`#` 后面直接结束（源码只有一个 `#`）就会在这里产生 `expected expression` 错误节点，这正是 4.3.4 实践会看到的树形。

**⑤ 公式与两种块**（[crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs:L227-L244](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L227-L244)）：`equation` 用 `p.enter_modes(SyntaxMode::Math, ...)` 进入数学模式，吃掉 `$`、解析 `Math` 节点、用 `expect_closing_delimiter` 等待收尾 `$`，最后 `wrap` 成 `Equation` 节点。[parser.rs:L748-L768](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L748-L768) 的 `code_block` / `content_block` 同理，分别用 `enter_modes` 切到 Code / Markup——「调用栈就是模式栈」。

**⑥ 模式切换的实现**（[crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs:L1791-L1830](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L1791-L1830)）：`enter_modes` 保存旧模式，设置词法器新模式，执行闭包，然后恢复旧模式并**重新词法分析当前 token**（因为同一段字符在 markup 和 code 下会分成不同的 token）。`with_nl_mode` 的文档注释说得很直白：「This function effectively repurposes the call stack as a stack of modes」。

**⑦ Parser 的状态**（[crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs:L1480-L1506](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L1480-L1506)）：`Parser` 持有共享文本 `text`、多模式 `lexer`、`nodes`（已产出的语法树节点，按序排列）、单 token 前瞻 `token`（`Token` 结构缓存了当前 token 的 kind、节点、前置 trivia 数量、换行信息）、`balanced`（括号是否配平）、记忆化用的 `memo` 与嵌套深度 `depth`。**已经解析好的节点以扁平 `Vec` 形式堆在 `nodes` 里，需要成组时用 `wrap` 收拢**——这就是「nested vectors of SyntaxNodes」的真正含义。

**⑧ 吃 token 与打包**（[crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs:L1750-L1789](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L1750-L1789)）：`eat` 把当前 token 的节点 push 进 `nodes` 再前移词法器；`wrap(from, kind)` 把 `from` 标记到当前 token 之前的所有节点 drain 出来，包成一个 `SyntaxNode::inner` 放回原位。配合 `marker()`（[parser.rs:L1702-L1712](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L1702-L1712)）记录的位置，「先解析孩子、再包装父亲」就是 Typst 建树的全部秘密。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`parse`、`parse_code`、`parse_math` 分别在什么场景被调用？

**答案**：`parse` 解析整个源文件（markup 是文档顶层）；`parse_code` 用于解析「纯代码」的片段（需要以代码模式为起点的输入场景）；`parse_math` 用于把一整段文本按公式解析。三者共享同一套 `Parser` 机制，只是初始 `SyntaxMode` 与主循环不同。

**练习 2**：标题标记（`HeadingMarker`，即行首的等号加空格）为什么只有出现在行首才生效？

**答案**：`markup_exprs` 主循环用 `at_start`（由 `p.had_newline()` 维护）追踪是否位于行首；`markup_expr` 的 match 分支写成 `SyntaxKind::HeadingMarker if at_start` 才调用 `heading(p)`，非行首的等号会走别的分支（被当作文本处理）。行首约束是 markup 模式区别于 code 模式的关键上下文敏感性。

**练习 3**：`Parser` 的 `token` 字段为什么说是「单 token 前瞻」？

**答案**：解析器任何时刻只持有当前 token（还没进 `nodes`），`current()`/`at()` 都只看它；`eat()` 之后才通过 `lex()` 取下一个。匹配分支时只能「看一眼前」，需要更多上下文的场合靠 `wrap`（事后成组）和 `memo`（回溯记忆化）弥补。

### 4.2 SyntaxNode 节点模型

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

`SyntaxNode` 是整个 typst-syntax 的中枢数据结构：parser 造它、AST 在它之上提供类型化视图（下一讲）、高亮器和 IDE 遍历它。它的设计目标是**无损 + 可增量维护**，也就是 rust-analyzer 一系的「绿树」思想（README 明确说 parser 结构 adapted from Rust Analyzer，[crates/typst-syntax/README.md:L31-L33](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/README.md#L31-L33)）。

「无损」体现在：树上保留一切 token（包括空白、注释这些 trivia），任意子树的文本拼接起来就是原文。「可增量维护」体现在三点：

1. 每个内部节点缓存了整棵子树的**摘要信息**（总字节长、总节点数、有无错误/警告），改一个孩子只需沿路径更新祖先的摘要；
2. 每个节点持有**编号区间**（span number），新节点插进来时尽量不动兄弟的编号；
3. 提供一整套**局部替换 + 重编号**的操作（`replace_children` / `renumber_children` / `update_parent`），供增量重解析使用。

> **重构提示**：第 3 点提到的三个方法**不再位于 node.rs**——它们已整体迁移到 reparser.rs 的 `impl InnerNode` 块中（见 4.2.3 ⑧）。node.rs 只保留树的「构造与查询」职责，把「修改」职责让给了重解析模块。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

一个节点的四种内部形态（`Node` 枚举，[node.rs:L52-L58](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/node.rs#L52-L58)）：

| 形态 | 存储内容 | 对应 `SyntaxKind` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Leaf(text, kind)` | token 原文 + 类别 | 除 Error 外的任意类别 |
| `Inner(Arc<InnerNode>, kind)` | 孩子列表 + 摘要 | 结构类别（Markup、Heading、Equation…） |
| `Error(Arc<ErrorNode>, kind)` | 错误消息 + 触发文本 + 提示 | 恒为 `SyntaxKind::Error` |
| `Warning(Arc<WarningWrapper>, kind)` | 包裹一个孩子 + 警告消息 | 同被包裹孩子的类别 |

文档注释（[node.rs:L27-L51](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/node.rs#L27-L51)）写明了不变式：**错误节点的 kind 恒为 `Error`，叶子和内部节点永远不是 `Error`**；警告只是「包装」，穿透后仍是原节点。由于警告把孩子的 kind 复制了一份，改 kind 时必须穿过警告逐层赋值（这正是 `Node::node_ref` / `Node::inner_mut` 两个辅助方法存在的理由，[node.rs:L67-L101](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/node.rs#L67-L101)）。

建树与聚合流程：

```text
SyntaxNode::leaf(kind, text)    → 叶子
SyntaxNode::inner(kind, kids)   → InnerNode::new(kids)：
      len         = Σ child.len()
      descendants = 1 + Σ child.descendants()
      diagnosis   = OR(所有 child.diagnosis)      ← 错误/警告向上冒泡缓存
SyntaxNode::error(msg, text)    → 错误节点
node.warn(msg)                  → 把现有节点包进 Warning
```

span 编号（`numberize`）把一个 `u64` 区间 `within` 分配给子树：先算步长

\[ \text{stride} = \left\lfloor \frac{\text{within.end} - \text{within.start}}{2 \times \text{descendants}} \right\rfloor \]

每个孩子分到「后代数 × stride」宽的子区间，节点自己的编号取其中点 \((start + end) / 2\)。刻意只用**左半边**空间，是为了「留出空位给未来的插入」——增量编辑插入新节点时，兄弟的编号可以保持不变。区间挤不下时返回 `Unnumberable`，调用方（reparser 的 `renumber_children` 会先向两侧指数扩容重试，仍失败才上报，最终由 `Source` 层退回更大范围的处理）。

**新签名的含义**：本轮重构后，`InnerNode::numberize` 接受四个参数——`span: Option<&mut Span>`、`id`、`range: Option<Range<usize>>`、`within`。两者互斥（源码里有 `debug_assert!(range.is_none(), "node_span and range are exclusive")`）：

- `span = Some(&mut 自身span)`、`range = None`：传统全量编号——给自己和所有孩子分配编号；
- `span = None`、`range = Some(子区间)`：**只给一段孩子重新编号，自己的编号不动**——这是为增量重解析新增的能力，替换了几个孩子之后无需触碰父节点已有的编号。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么错误不做成独立的顶层类型，而是 `Node` 枚举的一个变体？

**答案**：统一在 `SyntaxNode` 里，parser 的 `nodes: Vec<SyntaxNode>` 与所有 `wrap`/`children` 逻辑无需为错误特判类型；同时不变式「kind 为 Error 的节点只出现在 Error 变体里」由构造器断言和 `convert_to_kind` 的 panic 保证，诊断收集又能靠 `diagnosis` 摘要 O(1) 剪枝。

**练习 2**：`InnerNode` 为什么要缓存 `len` 和 `descendants`？

**答案**：CST 的文本与结构查询极高频（诊断定位、增量重解析、IDE 跳转都要「这个节点覆盖哪个字节区间」）。缓存后，任意节点的区间可由「祖先偏移累加 + 自身 len」直接得出；`numberize` 分配编号区间也直接依赖 `descendants`。没有缓存就要每次遍历子树。

**练习 3**：`numberize` 的步长为什么要除以 `2 * descendants` 而不是 `descendants`？

**答案**：只用区间左半边给现有节点编号，右半边留白。将来在中间插入新节点时，可以从留白中取号，**兄弟节点的编号保持稳定**，下游基于 span 的缓存（comemo 记忆化、增量编译）就不会大面积失效。这就是「绿树」为增量编译准备的编号方案。

**练习 4**：`InnerNode::numberize` 的 `span: Option<&mut Span>` 参数为什么设计成可空的？

**答案**：全量解析后编号时传 `Some(&mut self.span)`，要求同时给节点自身和孩子编号；增量重解析替换了一段孩子后，`renumber_children` 传 `None` 加 `Some(range)`，只重排那段孩子的编号、父节点编号保持不变。一个签名同时服务两种场景，避免了重复实现同一套 stride 分配逻辑。

### 4.3 容错与错误恢复策略

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

Typst 的解析阶段**永不返回 Err**：`parse(&str) -> SyntaxNode` 总是给出完整的树。所有语法错误都表现为树上的 `Error` 节点，后续阶段（求值、IDE）通过 `errors_and_warnings()` 把它们收集成 `SyntaxDiagnostic`。这带来三个直接好处：

1. 编辑器在文档半成品状态下仍能继续提供高亮、补全、预览；
2. 一次编译可以**同时**报告多个错误，而不是第一个错误就停；
3. 错误节点本身携带原文文本，树仍然无损，错误修复后增量重解析可以精确替换。

错误的来源分两类：词法错误（Lexer 发现非法字符序列，直接产出 kind 为 `Error` 的 token）与语法错误（Parser 发现结构不符合预期）。Parser 对两类错误的处理统一收敛到几个小函数。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

Parser 挂错误的四种方式：

```text
① expected_at(m, thing)   在标记 m 处「插入」一个零长 Error 节点
                           （不消耗任何 token，表示"这里缺东西"）
② node.unexpected()       把当前 token 吃掉并整体转成
                           Error("unexpected " + kind 名)
③ node.expected(name)     把已吃掉的 token 转成
                           Error("expected X, found Y")
④ expect_closing_delimiter(open, kind)
                           到结束都没等到右括号时，把开头 m 处的
                           左括号节点转成 Error("unclosed delimiter")
```

防级联与保底机制：

- `after_error()`：上一个非 trivia 节点已是错误时，`expected` 不再重复插入零长错误（避免一行错报十次）；
- `trim_errors()`：回滚掉末尾连续的零长错误节点，常在产生「更有信息量」的错误前先清理现场；
- `balanced` 标志：遇到未配平的分组括号就置 false，增量重解析（u2-l5）据此放弃局部重解析、退回更大范围；
- 深度保护：`check_depth_until` / `increase_depth` 超过 `MAX_DEPTH`（256）时调用 `depth_check_error`，它会**保证向前吃掉至少一个 token**（必要时顺带配平括号）再返回，防止死循环。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**① expected 家族**（[crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs:L1964-L2022](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L1964-L2022)）：`expect(kind)` 吃到就吃、吃不到就报 `expected` 加 kind 名；`expected_at(m, thing)` 构造一个文本为空串的 `SyntaxNode::error` 插入到标记处——注意文本为空串，所以是**零长错误**。`expected` 的注释（[parser.rs:L1991-L2009](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L1991-L2009)）特别有意思：当前 token 本身是错误 token 时要**把它吃掉再继续**，否则退出当前词法模式后，增量重解析可能在错误模式下重新分词，导致「全量解析不等于增量解析」——`#import "str` 未闭合字符串就是注释里给出的例子。这是容错设计与增量编译的深度耦合点。

**② unexpected 与节点级转换**（[crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs:L2034-L2038](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L2034-L2038) 与 [node.rs:L477-L526](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/node.rs#L477-L526)）：`unexpected()` 先 `trim_errors()` 再吃掉 token 并调节点级 `convert_to_error`（已是错误节点则保持原消息）。node.rs 侧的 `expected`/`unexpected` 还会补提示，例如把关键字误用为标识符时提示「keyword `x` is not allowed as an identifier; try `x_` instead」。

**③ 防级联**（[crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs:L2012-L2015](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L2012-L2015) 与 [parser.rs:L2041-L2051](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L2041-L2051)）：`after_error` 只看标记前一个节点的 kind 是否 `is_error()`（`SyntaxKind::is_error` 的判定见 [kind.rs:L418](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/kind.rs#L418)）；`trim_errors` 从尾部回收零长错误。

**④ 未闭合括号**（[crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs:L1981-L1987](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L1981-L1987)）：`expect_closing_delimiter` 找不到右括号时，把**开头**的左括号节点转成 `unclosed delimiter` 错误——错误精确落在「括号打开」的位置，比报在文件末尾有用得多。

**⑤ 兜底分支**：code 模式的 `code_primary` 尾部（[crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs:L666-L737](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L666-L737)）注释写明它会「Consume erroneous tokens for things like `#12p`, `#]`」——`#` 后跟不合法 token 时，要么 `unexpected()` 吃掉（atomic 情形），要么 `expected("expression")` 插零长错误。math 主循环（[parser.rs:L246-L262](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L246-L262)）同样：不属于 `set::MATH_EXPR` 的 token 一律 `unexpected()` 吃掉继续。markup 分发（[parser.rs:L89-L136](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L89-L136)）里多余的 `]` 也是 `unexpected()` 加一条提示「try using a backslash escape: \]」。

**⑥ 深度保护**（[crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs:L2061-L2112](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs#L2061-L2112)）：`increase_depth` 返回一个 RAII 守卫（`defer`），离开作用域自动减一；超限时 `depth_check_error` 的注释强调「must guarantee some sort of forward progress」——每个分支至少吃一个 token，这是容错解析不死的最后防线。

**⑦ 警告也是一种树节点**：`SyntaxNode::warn`（[node.rs:L137-L168](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/node.rs#L137-L168)）把既有节点包进 `WarningWrapper`（[node.rs:L861-L941](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/node.rs#L861-L941)），例如 `**`（空粗体）会得到「no text within stars」警告但**不阻断**解析——Strong 结构照常建出来。

#### 4.3.4 代码实践（本讲核心实践）

**实践目标**：打印一段含语法错误的源码的完整 `SyntaxNode` 树，亲眼确认「错误进树、解析不中断」。

**操作步骤**：

1. 仓库已经帮我们准备好读树工具：`node.rs` 测试模块里的 `test_debug`（[crates/typst-syntax/src/node.rs:L1387-L1444](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-syntax/src/node.rs#L1387-L1444)）用 `format!("{:#?}", crate::parse(...))` 断言了四棵真实树。先运行它建立直觉：

```bash
cargo test -p typst-syntax test_debug
```

2. 在同一个 `mod tests` 里添加自己的测试（示例代码）：

```rust
#[test]
fn test_error_does_not_stop_parsing() {
    // `#]` 是 code_primary 注释里点名的非法组合：
    // `#` 开启代码表达式，`]` 不是合法的代码开头
    let tree = crate::parse("Hi #] there *bold*");

    println!("{tree:#?}");   // 完整树，含 Error 节点
    let (errors, warnings) = tree.errors_and_warnings();
    println!("{} errors, {} warnings", errors.len(), warnings.len());
    for e in &errors {
        println!("  - {}", e.message);
    }
}
```

3. 运行：

```bash
cargo test -p typst-syntax test_error_does_not_stop_parsing -- --nocapture
```

**需要观察的现象**：树中 `#]` 附近出现一个 `Error` 节点（来自 `code_primary` 对 atomic 情形的 `p.unexpected()` 处理，消息形如 `unexpected right bracket`，具体措辞待本地验证）；**关键在于** `there *bold*` 之后的文本与 `Strong` 结构仍然完整地出现在树里。

**预期结果**：`errors` 至少 1 条；后续 `Text` 与 `Strong` 节点照常存在；整体根节点仍是完整的 `Markup: n [...]`。作为对照，`test_debug` 里 `parse("#")` 的断言树（真实源码中的断言，可直接引用）是：

```text
Markup: 1 [
    Hash: "#",
    Error: "expected expression",
]
```

而 `parse("**")` 得到的是包着完整 `Strong` 结构的 `Warning` 节点——错误与警告都只是树上的普通居民。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`expected_at` 插入的错误节点为什么文本是空串？空串错误和吃掉 token 的错误有什么分工？

**答案**：空串（零长）错误表示「这里**缺**一个东西」，不占据任何源码位置，纯粹是占位标记，用于缺分号、缺表达式等场景；吃掉 token 的错误（`unexpected`）表示「这里**多**了个不合法的东西」，错误节点携带该 token 的原文。`trim_errors` 专门回收零长错误，避免它们堆积。

**练习 2**：`expected()` 在当前 token 本身是错误 token 时为什么要吃掉它而不是只插入零长错误？

**答案**：源码注释（parser.rs:L1991-L2009）解释：若不吃掉就退出当前词法模式，之后增量重解析时这段文本可能在**markup 模式**下重新分词；例如 `#import "str` 的未闭合字符串若不被吃掉，将来补上右引号时增量解析可能不再把它当作字符串，导致全量解析与增量解析结果不一致。容错策略必须与增量编译保持一致。

**练习 3**：`depth_check_error` 为什么必须「至少吃掉一个 token」？

**答案**：深度超限的输入（如几百层括号）如果恢复逻辑不吃 token 就返回，外层循环的条件不变，会无限循环。保证前进（forward progress）是容错解析器不死循环的必要条件，函数注释明确写了这一点。

## 5. 综合实践

把本讲三个模块串成一个「预测—验证」闭环：

1. **准备输入**（可以直接把源码内联进测试，不必单独存文件）：

```typst

#let f(x) = x * 2
#f(3) and ## oops
- item one
```

预期：预测与实际树在孩子种类上完全一致；连续两个井号会产生一个带两条 hint 的 `Error` 节点（`test_debug` 已断言其形态），转义后消失。（整棵树的具体输出待本地验证。）

## 6. 本讲小结

- Typst 用**一套** `Parser` + 模式切换实现三语法：`#`、`$`、`{}`、`[]` 四个铰链通过 `enter_modes` 在 Markup/Code/Math 间切换，「调用栈即模式栈」。
- 解析产物是**无损 CST**：`SyntaxNode` 有 Leaf/Inner/Error/Warning 四种形态，trivia 也进树；内部节点缓存 `len`/`descendants`/`diagnosis` 摘要，支撑 O(1) 查询与增量维护。
- span 编号用「区间取半留白」的 stride 方案，为增量编辑预留插入空间；新签名 `InnerNode::numberize(Option<&mut Span>, .., Option<Range<usize>>, ..)` 让「只给孩子区间重编号」成为一等操作。
- 本轮重构把**修改类**方法（`replace_children` / `renumber_children` / `update_parent`）从 node.rs 迁入 reparser.rs 的 `impl InnerNode`，`InnerNode` 提升为 `pub(super)`，node.rs 专注于构造与查询；新增的 `reparse_inner_node_mut` 不穿透警告，保证重解析的健全性。
- 解析**永不失败**：错误以零长插入、token 转换、括号定位三种方式变成树上的 `Error` 节点；`after_error`/`trim_errors` 防级联，`balanced` 标志与 `MAX_DEPTH` 深度保护守住底线，且恢复逻辑保证向前推进。
- 容错设计与增量编译深度耦合：错误 token 必须被吃掉，以保证全量解析与增量重解析结果一致。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

- 下一讲（u2-l4）**AST 视图与 Span 定位系统**：`ast.rs` 如何在这棵「无类型」CST 之上提供零成本的类型化视图（`SyntaxNode` 与 AST 节点之间的 cast 关系），以及如何用 Span 从树反查源码字节区间。建议先重读本讲 4.2 的 `LinkedNode` 一节。

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool.     description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }

  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.
